scope: Theme-led FFTA design, with all 18 supports reviewed for cross-job mixing. Values and engine compatibility remain provisional.

drk: FFT: War of the Lions Dark Knight
drk14: Square Enix: FFXIV Dark Knight job guide
brd: Bard comparison: Hurdy in FFTA2 and FFT Bard
dnc: Dancer comparison: FFT, FFV, and FFTA2
axe14: Square Enix: FFXIV Warrior / Marauder job guide
mechanics: Terence Fergusson: original FFTA mechanics research

abilities.name: Ashura
abilities.effect: 1.10P non-elemental; after positive damage gain Centered. This action cannot consume or benefit from Centered.
abilities.anchor: Decisive draw that builds composure; original attack-and-prepare mechanic

abilities.name: Wind Draw
abilities.effect: 0.95P Wind per target. Can spend Centered for its damage bonus.
abilities.anchor: Original cutting wind released through katana technique

abilities.name: Osafune
abilities.effect: 0.85P non-elemental; after positive damage remove up to 10 MP from the target. No MP recovery. Centered boosts HP damage only.
abilities.anchor: MP-cutting blade spirit redesigned to also contribute HP damage

abilities.name: Murasame
abilities.target: r2 center, cross, allies including self; Sure
abilities.effect: Restore 25% target maximum HP, capped at 100 HP per target before Centered. Centered multiplies that capped amount by 1.25; final recovery is capped by missing HP.
abilities.anchor: Healing blade spirit, with reach and scaling chosen for frontline support

abilities.name: Kiyomori
abilities.target: Self cross, allies including self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply Protect and Shell. Does not consume Centered.
abilities.anchor: Protective blade spirits; group defense earns its action through multiple allies

abilities.name: Guarding Draw
abilities.effect: 0.90P non-elemental; after positive damage apply Protect to self. Can spend Centered for its damage bonus.
abilities.anchor: Original guarded sword strike that combines pressure with self-protection

abilities.name: Kiku-ichimonji
abilities.effect: 1.30P non-elemental. Can spend Centered for its damage bonus.
abilities.anchor: Far-reaching blade spirit redesigned as a precise ranged finisher

abilities.name: Moon Blossom
abilities.effect: 1.35P non-elemental per target; after damaging at least one enemy, apply Regen to self. Centered boosts the whole action once.
abilities.anchor: Original culminating spirit release, with offensive and sustaining roles

abilities.name: Composure
abilities.effect: During your own turn, direct HP damage dealt and direct restorative HP healing applied ×1.15 if you have not voluntarily moved before that action starts. Moving afterward is allowed. No weapon, command, or Centered requirement. Does not boost item healing, drain recovery, MP effects, or reaction damage.
abilities.anchor: Calm, deliberate action; useful with attacks, techniques, and magic
abilities.buildExamples: Human Archer holding a firing position; Human Black Mage casting before moving

abilities.name: Poise
abilities.effect: Direct physical and magical HP damage received ×0.85 while at least one beneficial status is active at the start of the incoming action. Qualifying effects are Protect, Shell, Haste, Regen, Float, Invisible, or a tagged temporary beneficial effect such as Centered, Last Resort, or a Spellblade enchantment. Additional statuses do not increase the bonus. No katana or source-job requirement; costs and damage-over-time are excluded.
abilities.anchor: Maintaining composure under protection; benefits can come from allies or another command
abilities.buildExamples: Human Paladin with Protect; Human Blue Mage supported by an allied buffer

abilities.name: Blade Ward
abilities.effect: Requires katana. 40% pre-hit activation: incoming enemy physical HP damage ×0.70 for that action, including physical A-abilities. No counter.
abilities.anchor: Original blade defense with a broader trigger than a Fight-only evasion move

abilities.name: Counter Draw
abilities.effect: After surviving adjacent enemy physical HP damage, 35% activation: counter once for 0.70P non-elemental, A accuracy. Requires katana. Positive counter damage grants Centered; the counter cannot consume or benefit from Centered.
abilities.anchor: Original reactive draw that prepares the next deliberate technique

abilities.name: Crescent Combo
abilities.anchor: Original job-specific label for vanilla Judge Point combo participation
abilities.effect: Requires katana; range 1. Standard vanilla combo. No extra element, status, healing, drain, critical, enchantment, terrain, or support rider.

abilities.name: Blood Edge
abilities.effect: 1.30P Dark.
abilities.anchor: Original introductory sword technique built around the job's health sacrifice

abilities.name: Sanguine Sword
abilities.effect: 0.85P non-elemental; heal 25% of actual HP removed, capped at 10% user max HP. Undead reverse drain.
abilities.anchor: HP-draining sword art

abilities.name: Infernal Strike
abilities.effect: Remove floor(0.20 × the 1.00P non-elemental damage reference) MP, capped at target current MP and 12. Restore exactly the MP removed to user, capped at missing MP. No HP damage.
abilities.anchor: MP-draining sword art

abilities.name: Dark Mind
abilities.effect: Apply Shell. FFXIV's defensive ability is represented by a familiar FFTA magic ward; this is not its full current mitigation profile.
abilities.anchor: Personal protection against magic

abilities.name: Last Resort
abilities.effect: T2: physical HP damage dealt ×1.20 and physical HP damage received ×1.20. Both parts form one effect and expire or are dispelled together.
abilities.anchor: Attack at the expense of defense

abilities.name: Crushing Blow
abilities.target: r2, one enemy; A then S ×0.5
abilities.effect: 1.00P weapon-elemental; after positive damage attempt Stop.
abilities.anchor: Sword damage with Stop

abilities.name: Abyssal Blade
abilities.effect: Weapon-elemental: 1.40P at tile 1, 1.10P at tile 2, 0.80P at tile 3. Pay HP once. A straight line replaces the source's cone.
abilities.anchor: Health sacrifice, distance-falloff wave

abilities.name: Unholy Sacrifice
abilities.target: Self cross, any units except self; A then S ×0.5
abilities.effect: 1.50P Dark to each target; after positive damage attempt Slow. Never drains.
abilities.anchor: Health sacrifice, dark area damage and Slow

abilities.name: Desperation
abilities.effect: Direct physical and magical HP damage dealt ×1.30 while at 35% maximum HP or less, checked after paying costs. Works with any weapon and command. Does not increase HP costs, healing, MP damage, item effects, or damage-over-time.
abilities.anchor: Dangerous offense at low health, usable by martial and magical builds
abilities.buildExamples: Human Black Mage risking low HP; Bangaa Gladiator using wounded-state burst

abilities.name: Bloodcasting
abilities.effect: For a voluntarily selected action with an MP cost, pay 2 HP per MP that would otherwise be spent, and spend no MP. Add any native HP cost separately; the combined payment must leave at least 1 HP. Pay after target validation and before accuracy, once per action. Costs trigger no reactions and cannot be reduced by damage protection. Items, JP, and non-MP costs are unchanged. Applies to every command; does not grant access to a command or change its Silence rules.
abilities.anchor: Trade life for action resources across spell and technique sets
abilities.buildExamples: Human Illusionist using HP to fuel Phantasm; Bangaa Bishop spending HP for Prayer

abilities.name: Dark Ward
abilities.effect: After surviving enemy magical HP damage, 35% activation: apply Shell to self. Does not reduce the triggering damage.
abilities.anchor: Original reactive variant of the Dark Mind ward

abilities.name: Vengeful Pulse
abilities.effect: After surviving adjacent enemy physical damage, 30% activation: retaliate for Dark damage equal to 20% of HP actually lost, capped at 10% user max HP. No hit roll; elemental immunity/absorption applies. No healing.
abilities.anchor: Original dark retaliation fueled by injury

abilities.name: Abyss Combo
abilities.anchor: Original job-specific label for vanilla Judge Point combo participation
abilities.effect: Requires sword, greatsword, or broadsword; range 1. Standard vanilla combo. No extra element, status, healing, drain, critical, enchantment, terrain, or support rider.

abilities.name: Thunder
abilities.effect: M24 Lightning. Use the original Thunder damage/effect routine where possible, preserving the new command's targeting.
abilities.anchor: Lightning spell

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.effect: Use the original Steal Gil payout and per-target success restrictions. No invented unlimited gil source.
abilities.anchor: Gil theft

abilities.name: Strong-Arm
abilities.target: r1, one enemy; A then S
abilities.effect: 0.75P weapon-elemental; after positive damage attempt original Steal: Access. against an eligible accessory. A failed or unavailable theft does not cancel damage. This narrows A2 item theft to an existing FFTA theft category; no generic Steal Item command is assumed.
abilities.anchor: Damage plus item theft, adapted to accessories

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.target: Self cross, allies including self; Sure
abilities.effect: T2: reduce incoming hostile S-check success chances by 15 percentage points, minimum 0. Does not affect attacks, damage, or effects that do not make a status check; immunity still wins.
abilities.anchor: Ailment resilience, not Attack

abilities.name: Thundara
abilities.target: r3 center, cross, any units; A
abilities.effect: M32 Lightning to each target.
abilities.anchor: Mid-tier lightning magic

abilities.name: Pillage
abilities.target: r1, one enemy; A then S
abilities.effect: 0.85P weapon-elemental; after positive damage attempt the original Steal Armor transaction against body equipment only. Preserve protection and theft immunity.
abilities.anchor: Damage plus armor theft

abilities.name: Thundaga
abilities.target: r3 center, cross, any units; A
abilities.effect: M40 Lightning to each target.
abilities.anchor: High-tier lightning magic

abilities.name: Tsunami
abilities.target: r4 center, cross, any units; A
abilities.effect: M36 Water on any terrain. If mapped water occupies the caster tile or an orthogonally adjacent tile within 2 height, successful positive damage also removes up to 8 MP per target. No MP recovery and no water-movement permission.
abilities.anchor: Sea power redesigned to function on land, with water proximity enhancing its effect

abilities.name: Sea Legs
abilities.effect: Ignore forced tile displacement. Works with every job and weapon. Does not stop Immobilize, Slow, voluntary movement, or terrain harm, and does not grant water traversal.
abilities.anchor: A raider keeps their footing; transferable positional protection
abilities.buildExamples: Bangaa Dragoon keeping a useful position; Bangaa Templar resisting knockback

abilities.name: Opportunist
abilities.effect: Direct physical and magical HP damage dealt ×1.20 against a target with at least one harmful status at the start of the action. Qualifying examples include Poison, Blind, Silence, Slow, Immobilize, Disable, Confuse, Sleep, and tagged custom debuffs. Multiple ailments do not multiply the bonus. The action cannot qualify itself by applying a status after its own damage. No weapon or theft requirement.
abilities.anchor: A raider exploits openings created by any ally or command
abilities.buildExamples: Bangaa Warrior attacking a blinded target; Bangaa Bishop exploiting an ally-applied debuff

abilities.name: Absorb Damage
abilities.effect: After surviving positive enemy HP damage, 35% activation: recover 10% of actual HP lost. Does not reverse lethal hits or trigger from HP costs.
abilities.anchor: Damage recovery; a chance and lockout are added here

abilities.name: Gil Snapper
abilities.effect: After surviving an enemy critical physical hit, 35% activation: gain floor(0.5 × actual HP lost) gil, capped at 50 per battle per unit. No cost to the attacker's inventory.
abilities.anchor: Gil after a critical hit; payout and battle cap are ours

abilities.name: Tempest Combo
abilities.anchor: Original job-specific label for vanilla Judge Point combo participation
abilities.effect: Requires axe; range 1. Standard vanilla combo. No extra element, status, healing, drain, critical, enchantment, terrain, or support rider.

abilities.name: Stone Pulse
abilities.target: r3 center, cross, any units except caster; A
abilities.effect: M26 Earth. Rock affinity increases damage ×1.20.
abilities.anchor: Original reliable earth pressure; terrain rewards damage rather than unlocking the spell

abilities.name: Tanglevine
abilities.target: r3, one enemy; A then S
abilities.effect: M24 non-elemental; after positive damage attempt Immobilize with S. Vegetation affinity adds 15 percentage points to the final S chance, capped at 95% before defensive reductions; immunity still wins.
abilities.anchor: Binding vegetation with a useful damage baseline and a stronger native control effect

abilities.name: Torrent
abilities.target: r3 center, cross, any units except caster; A
abilities.effect: M28 Water. With water affinity, after positive damage push each target one tile in the chosen cardinal direction if legal. Blocked displacement leaves damage intact.
abilities.anchor: Original wave control that breaks formations rather than copying a transformation rider

abilities.name: Updraft
abilities.target: r3, one ally or self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply Float and Move +1 for T2. If caster stands at least two height units above target, also grant Jump +1 for T2. No immediate movement, flight, or new permission to occupy impassable tiles. Float uses its normal status removal rules.
abilities.anchor: Original wind assistance; positioning and traversal utility

abilities.name: Earthen Ward
abilities.target: r3 center, cross, allies including self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply Protect. With rock affinity, also prevent forced displacement for T2. Does not prevent voluntary movement or Immobilize.
abilities.anchor: Original earth protection that steadies an allied formation

abilities.name: Wisp Flame
abilities.effect: M28 Fire; after positive damage inflict Wisp Exposure for T2: magical HP damage received ×1.15. Wood/heat affinity instead applies ×1.25. This new debuff has no second success roll; immunity to the new effect prevents the rider, not damage.
abilities.anchor: Original spirit flame that creates an opening for allied magic

abilities.name: Rime Field
abilities.target: r3 center, cross, any units except caster; A
abilities.effect: M28 Ice, then place a frost field on the targeted cross even if damage misses. Entering a field tile costs one additional Move point for any grounded unit, including allies. Ice affinity also attempts Slow with S after positive damage.
abilities.anchor: Original persistent ice terrain for area denial; native ice adds further control

abilities.name: Gaia Surge
abilities.target: r4 center, cross, any units except caster; A
abilities.effect: M40 with an element selected from available nearby affinities: Earth for rock, Water for water, Fire for wood/heat, Ice for ice. Wind is always available. No affinity is consumed; this action has no additional native damage bonus.
abilities.anchor: Original major nature release whose elemental options respond to surroundings

abilities.name: Attunement
abilities.effect: Elemental direct HP damage dealt ×1.20 when the resolved element is a weakness of the target after ordinary affinity rules. Applies to any physical or magical attack, including elemental weapons and secondary commands. Requires neither Geomancy nor nearby terrain. Neutral, resisted, immune, absorbed, non-elemental, healing, and damage-over-time outcomes gain nothing.
abilities.anchor: Understand elemental vulnerability and apply that knowledge to any technique
abilities.buildExamples: Nu Mou Black Mage exploiting weaknesses; Nu Mou Sage choosing an appropriate element

abilities.name: Surefoot
abilities.effect: Jump +1. Entering an otherwise legally traversable tile pays its normal one-tile movement cost without added terrain movement surcharges, including Rime Field. Does not remove height restrictions, environmental damage or ailments, blocking units, or impassability; no flight or extra movement action.
abilities.anchor: Read and traverse difficult ground, regardless of current profession
abilities.buildExamples: Nu Mou Beastmaster reaching a useful position; Nu Mou Alchemist crossing slowed ground

abilities.name: Stone Skin
abilities.effect: After surviving enemy physical HP damage, 40% activation: apply Protect to self. Works on any terrain.
abilities.anchor: Original earthen defense with a dependable opportunity to contribute across maps

abilities.name: Nature's Wrath
abilities.effect: After surviving enemy HP damage, 35% activation: counter that attacker alone within r3 for M20, A accuracy. Choose the element of the highest-AP learned damaging Geomancy action; Gaia Surge uses the selected current affinity if available, otherwise Wind. No ailment, field, displacement, or Attunement bonus. No learned damaging action means no counter.
abilities.anchor: Reactive nature power; neither terrain permission nor a tiny status chance is required for its contribution

abilities.name: Gaia Combo
abilities.anchor: Original job-specific label for vanilla Judge Point combo participation
abilities.effect: Requires rod or mace; range 1. Standard vanilla combo. No extra element, status, healing, drain, critical, enchantment, terrain, or support rider.

abilities.name: Potion
abilities.target: r4, one ally or self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply the vanilla Potion effect.
abilities.anchor: Basic restorative

abilities.name: Antidote
abilities.target: r4, one ally or self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply the vanilla Antidote cure.
abilities.anchor: Poison treatment

abilities.name: Phoenix Down
abilities.effect: Apply the vanilla Phoenix Down revival, minimum 1 HP.
abilities.anchor: Item-based revival

abilities.name: Hi-Potion
abilities.target: r4, one ally or self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply the vanilla Hi-Potion effect.
abilities.anchor: Stronger restorative

abilities.name: Eye Drops
abilities.target: r4, one ally or self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply the vanilla Eye Drops cure. It treats blindness rather than causing it.
abilities.anchor: Blindness treatment

abilities.name: Ether
abilities.target: r4, one ally or self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply the vanilla Ether MP recovery.
abilities.anchor: MP restorative

abilities.name: Cureall
abilities.target: r4, one ally or self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply the vanilla Cureall cure list; additionally clear our new harmful Polka, Heathen Frolic, Exposed, and Wisp Exposure modifiers. Does not remove Last Resort's drawback separately from its benefit.
abilities.anchor: FFT Remedy role using the actual FFTA consumable Cureall

abilities.name: X-Potion
abilities.target: r4, one ally or self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply the vanilla X-Potion effect.
abilities.anchor: High-grade restorative

abilities.name: Pharmacology
abilities.effect: Direct HP and MP restoration from consumed restorative items ×1.50, then round down and cap at the recipient's missing resource. Applies to ordinary Item, Chemist actions, other consumable-based commands, and item-consuming reactions such as Auto-Potion. Does not improve revival HP, cure lists, drain, or magic; full restoration remains full restoration. Only the item user's support supplies this modifier.
abilities.anchor: Expert medicine preparation transfers to any use of supplies
abilities.buildExamples: Moogle Gunner with ordinary Item; Nu Mou Alchemist using restorative supplies

abilities.name: Long Throw
abilities.effect: For a consumable-based single-target action that can normally target another unit, a base range below 4 becomes 4; a base range of 4 or more gains +1, capped at 5 and never reduced below its original range. Applies to ordinary Item, Chemist applications, and eligible future mixtures. Retain target, height, and line-of-sight restrictions. Does not turn self-only or area effects into ranged single-target effects, and does not extend weapon attacks.
abilities.anchor: Throw supplies accurately across the battlefield from any job
abilities.buildExamples: Moogle Thief with ranged Item support; Nu Mou White Mage delivering an emergency item

abilities.name: Auto-Potion
abilities.effect: After surviving enemy HP damage at 30% HP or below, 50% activation: consume one Potion and apply its vanilla recovery to self. Never substitute Hi-Potion or X-Potion. Requires stock; Pharmacology applies if equipped.
abilities.anchor: Automatic inventory-funded treatment; selection and threshold adapted

abilities.name: Auto-Cureall
abilities.effect: After surviving an enemy action that inflicted a Cureall-curable ailment, 35% activation: consume one Cureall and apply its cure to self. Requires stock and ability to react; cannot rescue KO or bypass reaction-blocking statuses.
abilities.anchor: Original extension of emergency item use; no free magical regeneration

abilities.name: Flask Combo
abilities.anchor: Original job-specific label for vanilla Judge Point combo participation
abilities.effect: Requires knife or mace; range 1. Standard vanilla combo. No extra element, status, healing, drain, critical, enchantment, terrain, or support rider.

abilities.name: Soul Etude
abilities.target: r3, one ally or self; Sure
abilities.effect: Heal 20% target max HP, capped at 100; remove Poison, Blind, Silence, and Confuse. Cannot sing it while already Silenced.
abilities.anchor: Healing plus cleansing

abilities.name: Battle Chant
abilities.target: Self cross, allies including self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply Protect, our representation of A2 defense enhancement.
abilities.anchor: Defense song

abilities.name: Magickal Refrain
abilities.target: Self cross, allies including self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply Shell, our representation of A2 resistance enhancement.
abilities.anchor: Magical defense song

abilities.name: Requiem
abilities.effect: M32 Holy; invalid against living targets. No instant KO or resurrection suppression.
abilities.anchor: Anti-undead song

abilities.name: Angelsong
abilities.target: Self cross, allies including self; Sure
abilities.effect: Apply Regen.
abilities.anchor: Regeneration song

abilities.name: Hide
abilities.effect: Apply the original Invisible status with its ordinary break/removal rules. Does not give movement or an extra action.
abilities.anchor: Self-concealment

abilities.name: Magick Ballad
abilities.target: r3, one ally other than caster; Sure
abilities.effect: Restore 8 MP, capped at missing MP. Self-targeting excluded; any remaining two-Bard economy must be evaluated in balance testing.
abilities.anchor: MP-restoring song

abilities.name: Nameless Song
abilities.target: Self cross, allies including self; Sure
abilities.effect: For each ally choose uniformly from Protect, Shell, Regen, and Haste, then apply that status. No reroll for existing status or immunity. Preview shows the four possibilities.
abilities.anchor: Random beneficial song

abilities.name: Encouragement
abilities.effect: When a voluntary action successfully adds a new beneficial status to another ally, also restore 10% of that ally's maximum HP, capped at 30 HP before incoming-healing modifiers. Once per ally per action, even if several statuses are applied. Applies to all commands. Refreshing an existing status or its duration does not qualify; merely healing or curing does not qualify. No self-target bonus or reaction trigger.
abilities.anchor: Inspiring aid makes protective and enhancing actions more useful
abilities.buildExamples: Moogle Time Mage granting Haste; Moogle Animist applying a beneficial effect

abilities.name: Clear Voice
abilities.effect: Immune to Silence while equipped, regardless of job, weapon, or command. No protection against other ailments. Does not grant magic, an instrument, or access to a voice-based command. Ordinary status-immunity handling applies.
abilities.anchor: Vocal discipline protects both songs and spellcasting
abilities.buildExamples: Moogle Black Mage preserving casting; Moogle Time Mage preserving support magic

abilities.name: Magick Boost
abilities.effect: After surviving enemy magical HP damage, 35% activation: magical HP damage dealt ×1.15, T2. Does not strengthen fixed or percent healing.
abilities.anchor: FFT Bard's reactive magical growth made temporary

abilities.name: Encore
abilities.effect: After surviving enemy physical HP damage, 35% activation: with an instrument and while not Silenced, recover 5% max HP through a brief reprise. No cleanse or revival.
abilities.anchor: Original reduced self-reprise of Soul Etude

abilities.name: Chorus Combo
abilities.anchor: Original job-specific label for vanilla Judge Point combo participation
abilities.effect: Requires instrument; range 1. Standard vanilla combo. No extra element, status, healing, drain, critical, enchantment, terrain, or support rider.

abilities.name: Mincing Minuet
abilities.effect: Physical damage using a virtual non-elemental weapon of Attack 12 in the normal P reference. Actual weapon Attack, element, and procs do not enter this formula.
abilities.anchor: Area HP-damaging dance

abilities.name: Witch Hunt
abilities.effect: Remove 6 MP from each successful target, capped at current MP. No recovery to dancer.
abilities.anchor: MP-damaging dance

abilities.name: Slow Dance
abilities.effect: Apply Slow. A timed FFTA status replaces the source's direct Speed reduction.
abilities.anchor: Disrupt enemy tempo

abilities.name: Polka
abilities.effect: T2: physical HP damage dealt ×0.85.
abilities.anchor: Weaken physical offense

abilities.name: Heathen Frolic
abilities.effect: T2: magical HP damage dealt ×0.85. Does not weaken item effects, fixed damage, or healing.
abilities.anchor: Weaken magical offense

abilities.name: Forbidden Dance
abilities.effect: For each target choose uniformly from Blind, Silence, Poison, and Confuse; then make its S check. Do not reroll immunities. No Petrify, KO, or turn reset in the pool.
abilities.anchor: Random ailments with a restricted pool

abilities.name: Jitterbug
abilities.effect: 0.75P using a virtual non-elemental weapon of Attack 18. Drain 50% of actual HP removed, capped at 15% user max HP. Undead reverse drain.
abilities.anchor: HP-draining dance

abilities.name: Sword Dance
abilities.effect: 1.60P weapon-elemental, one hit. Unlike FFV's random Dance result, select it directly after learning and pay MP.
abilities.anchor: FFV physical dance finisher

abilities.name: Grace
abilities.effect: Base Evade +10 before ordinary facing, equipment calculations, and caps. Applies with any job and weapon; it is not a universal ten-percentage-point dodge bonus against every effect.
abilities.anchor: Evasive footwork transferable to any combat style
abilities.buildExamples: Viera Fencer defending in melee; Viera Red Mage taking a frontline role

abilities.name: Light Foot
abilities.effect: Move +1 on any current job. No second movement action, flight, terrain immunity, or free ability slot.
abilities.anchor: A performer's mobility becomes a general positioning tool
abilities.buildExamples: Viera Summoner reaching a casting position; Viera Sniper relocating for a shot

abilities.name: Fury
abilities.effect: After surviving enemy physical HP damage, 35% activation: physical HP damage dealt ×1.15, T2. No permanent stat growth.
abilities.anchor: FFT Dancer's reactive offense made temporary

abilities.name: Counter Rhythm
abilities.effect: After surviving adjacent enemy physical HP damage, 30% activation: attempt Slow on that attacker with S.
abilities.anchor: Original reactive echo of Slow Dance

abilities.name: Waltz Combo
abilities.anchor: Original job-specific label for vanilla Judge Point combo participation
abilities.effect: Requires knife or rapier; range 1. Standard vanilla combo. No extra element, status, healing, drain, critical, enchantment, terrain, or support rider.

abilities.name: Fire Spellblade
abilities.effect: Primary Fight strike becomes Fire-elemental. No separate spell hit or damage bonus beyond elemental interaction.
abilities.anchor: Fire enchantment

abilities.name: Blizzard Spellblade
abilities.effect: Primary Fight strike becomes Ice-elemental.
abilities.anchor: Ice enchantment

abilities.name: Thunder Spellblade
abilities.effect: Primary Fight strike becomes Lightning-elemental.
abilities.anchor: Lightning enchantment

abilities.name: Poison Spellblade
abilities.effect: Primary Fight strike becomes non-elemental; after positive damage attempt Poison with S ×0.5.
abilities.anchor: Poison enchantment

abilities.name: Sleep Spellblade
abilities.effect: Primary Fight strike becomes non-elemental; after positive damage attempt Sleep with S ×0.5. Resolve the sleep after damage, so the same hit does not immediately wake the target.
abilities.anchor: Sleep enchantment

abilities.name: Silence Spellblade
abilities.effect: Primary Fight strike becomes non-elemental; after positive damage attempt Silence with S ×0.5.
abilities.anchor: Silence enchantment

abilities.name: Drain Spellblade
abilities.effect: Primary Fight strike becomes non-elemental; heal 20% of actual HP removed, capped at 8% user max HP per action. Undead reverse drain.
abilities.anchor: Draining enchantment

abilities.name: Flare Spellblade
abilities.effect: Primary Fight strike becomes non-elemental and uses 75% of the target's effective Weapon Defense in its damage calculation. No extra damage multiplier. This is a much smaller defense bypass than FFV.
abilities.anchor: Non-elemental defense-piercing enchantment

abilities.name: Spellweave
abilities.effect: Alternate a voluntary incanted magic action and a physical-damage action. If the current action is the opposite category to the preceding qualifying action, its direct HP damage ×1.20; any physical weapon or command qualifies. Spellblade preparation counts as magic even though it causes no damage, so it can prepare a boosted physical attack. An action with no qualifying category breaks the sequence; repeating a category sets that as the last category without a bonus. No healing, drain-recovery, item, or reaction bonus. Magic acts resolve using an explicit command/effect classification, not simply a nonzero MP cost.
abilities.anchor: Combine martial and magical actions across different command sets
abilities.buildExamples: Viera Red Mage alternating magic and Lunge Tech; Viera Elementalist with a physical secondary set

abilities.name: Arcane Ward
abilities.effect: Magical HP damage received ×0.75 while current MP is at least 50% of maximum MP at the start of the incoming action, with at least 1 MP remaining. Does not spend MP, absorb a spell, or reduce HP costs. Works with every job and weapon.
abilities.anchor: Maintained magical reserves protect their bearer
abilities.buildExamples: Viera White Mage conserving MP; Viera Summoner holding a defensive reserve

abilities.name: Magic Shell
abilities.effect: After surviving enemy HP damage at 30% max HP or less, 50% activation: apply Shell. Does not reduce the triggering hit; not blocked merely by Silence.
abilities.anchor: FFV low-health Shell placed in FFTA's reaction slot

abilities.name: Spell Parry
abilities.effect: Requires a qualifying equipped weapon and active enchantment. 25% pre-hit activation: incoming enemy physical HP damage ×0.5 for that action. Does not consume the enchantment.
abilities.anchor: Original magically reinforced sword guard

abilities.name: Spellblade Combo
abilities.anchor: Original job-specific label for vanilla Judge Point combo participation
abilities.effect: Requires rapier or saber; range 1. Standard vanilla combo. No extra element, status, healing, drain, critical, enchantment, terrain, or support rider.

abilities.name: Chop
abilities.effect: 1.05P. Basic weapon-elemental strike.
abilities.anchor: Original straightforward addition to Soldier's martial toolkit

abilities.name: Tomahawk
abilities.effect: 0.70P weapon-elemental thrown-axe strike. Requires clear line of sight. Does not consume or unequip the axe and does not pull the target.
abilities.anchor: Marauder ranged axe attack; no MMO enmity

abilities.name: Overpower
abilities.effect: 0.75P weapon-elemental per target. Our directional area and friendly fire adapt the axe area-attack concept. No enmity system.
abilities.anchor: Marauder area axe attack

abilities.name: Shatter Guard
abilities.effect: 0.85P weapon-elemental; after positive damage remove Protect only. No item destruction or permanent Defense loss.
abilities.anchor: Original guard-breaking extension of Soldier's weakening techniques

abilities.name: Recuperation
abilities.effect: Direct HP healing received ×1.25 from any eligible restorative source, including medicine and allied or self healing. Round down after combining modifiers and cap at missing HP. Does not improve revival HP, drain, regeneration ticks, or MP recovery. No axe, weapon, or command requirement.
abilities.anchor: Frontline recovery training, useful to any unit taking sustained damage
abilities.buildExamples: Human Fighter supported by a healer; Human Paladin benefiting from restorative actions

abilities.name: Haft Guard
abilities.effect: Requires axe. 25% pre-hit activation: enemy physical HP damage ×0.75 for that action.
abilities.anchor: Original mundane defense using the axe haft

abilities.name: Armor Splitter
abilities.effect: 1.00P weapon-elemental using 75% of target effective Weapon Defense for this hit. No lasting debuff or destroyed armor.
abilities.anchor: Original heavy-weapon penetration added to Gladiator's offensive kit

abilities.name: Reaping Arc
abilities.effect: 0.95P weapon-elemental per target. A directional alternative to existing Wild Swing, not a claim that Gladiator lacked area attacks.
abilities.anchor: Original positional variant alongside Wild Swing

abilities.name: Executioner
abilities.effect: 1.20P weapon-elemental; 1.60P if target is at or below 35% max HP at execution. No instant KO.
abilities.anchor: Original arena finisher; no claim of a canonical FFTA move

abilities.name: Fell Cleave
abilities.effect: 1.80P weapon-elemental. Apply Exposed before the hit, even on a miss: physical HP damage received ×1.20 until start of next user turn.
abilities.anchor: Warrior heavy axe strike; MP and Exposed replace MMO resources

abilities.name: Follow Through
abilities.effect: During your own turn, direct physical HP damage dealt ×1.15 if you voluntarily moved at least one tile before the action begins. Applies to every weapon and physical command. Extra distance gives no additional bonus; forced displacement and later movement do not qualify. No magic, item, reaction, or damage-over-time bonus.
abilities.anchor: Carry movement into an attack; transferable offensive momentum
abilities.buildExamples: Bangaa Warrior advancing into combat; Bangaa Dragoon moving before a physical technique

abilities.name: Axe Reprisal
abilities.effect: Requires axe. After surviving adjacent enemy physical HP damage, 30% activation: counter once for 0.70P, A accuracy. No proc or critical.
abilities.anchor: Original axe counter; compare with existing Strikeback rather than claiming a new role
